scope: Agda proof lane and bounded exact UAP theorem surface

before.agda_lane: Guix agda and agda-stdlib packages were realized before kernel checking.
before.ci_bootstrap: pullAfterInstall=true used %default-channels and introduced a large moving Guix pull.
before.theorems: boundedUniversalExactApproximation-through-continuousLeftInverse existed; three bounded exact-UAP corollaries were absent.

change.agda: Use official Agda 2.8.0.2 and stdlib 2.4 through agda/agda-setup-action pinned at commit c931d59d76a036d1bed9f322cc12cc105bda7881.
change.guix: Use ROCKTAKEY/guix-install-action with pullAfterInstall=false as the pure CI driver.
change.mercury: Require the three bounded-UAP corollaries in the forced theorem dependency contract.

verification_target: Guix Agda lane must print Agda 2.8.0.2 and execute Agda --safe on the canonical learner, theorem monolith, and focused tests.
rollback: Revert the Agda setup action, restore Guix Agda packages, restore pullAfterInstall=true, and remove the three UAP corollaries plus their Mercury dependencies.
